rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved providers incl. NBCC, AASECT, ASCH, NASW, APA, CSWF, ASWB, ABPP, American Psychiatric Association, IAMFC, AASCB, ACA, AMHCA, AAMFT, AMFTRB; medical errors course from a Board-approved provider; 3 h for attending a Board meeting, up to 10 h presenting/moderating, up to 5 h teaching a graduate course; no limit on home study
